test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following options is 6th to the right of the 17th letter from the left in the English alphabet ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

According to the question:

1) 17th letter from the left ⇒ Q

 
 

 **English alphabetic series**
 
 

 **Left**
 A B C D E F G H I J K L M N O P __**Q**__ R S T U V W X Y Z
 **Right**
 
 

2) 6th to the right of the 17th letter from the left ⇒ W

 
 

 English alphabetic series
 
 

 Left
 A B C D E F G H I J K L M N O P __**Q**__ R S T U V __**W**__ X Y Z
 Right
 
 

Thus, 6th to the right of the 17th letter from the left in the English alphabet is 'W'.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__****1) 17th letter from the left ⇒ Q (17) **

**2) 6th to the right of the 17th letter from the left ⇒ Q (17) + 6 ⇒ W (23)**
